desc: Zeus Arms "ARTEMIS" AR-15 Lower Receiver. The Artemis series lower is cut from a solid block of 7075 Aluminum. It also shows no visible markings on the sides of the receiver maximizing the amount of space for customization. All of our lowers feature a more aggressive magwell flare and a upper retention threaded hole.This complete lower allows you to build a "normal" AR-15 in compliant states such as California. This lower comes equipped with a Phase 5 B.A.D. lever and will make any mil-spec upper function as a non-semi-automatic. It will allow the upper to fire, extract, and automatically hold the bolt open. By definition, because the gun does not load the next round on its own without user input, it is not a semi-automatic firearm, which means it does not have to follow any featureless restrictions found on other firearms. The Phase 5 lever allows you to rapidly load your next round without adjusting your grip.
